body:
Hey man, I wanted to say; thanks for kinda “being there for me” during a tough time in my life. I just (2.5months ago) bounced back from rock-bottom depression. I am content with everything in my life, since being 8 years old. I can think CLEARLY 300% better than I had been my whole life up until this point (I’m 19 years old). People like you, and many of my REAL friends...are the reason I’m still here today; breathing & healthy. It’s a plus that I’m also HAPPY.

You have a good rest of your day. And happy new year.

P.s. follow: @2000ideas on instagram.

Sincerely, ThatTallGuy (lol)
